scope: independent read-only review of intermediate analyst reasoning; not injected into live tasks

issues.text: raw score magnitudes are dominated by symbol-specific volatility
issues.assessment: Not established by three sample dispersion summaries or matching rankings. Treat only as a motivation for an exploratory comparison, not a causal/dominance result.

issues.text: zero returns are at most a single observation per symbol, so a five-return window still yields positive SD
issues.assessment: The implication is invalid: constant nonzero returns can also have zero SD. Positivity must be computed for each actual window. The host inspection, not this inference, establishes denominators on the frozen sample.

gate: Final candidate/report and review must be assessed separately; intermediate finding status=hypothesis does not validate factual subclaims.
